appraiser_land.rule: where no vacant-lot sales are nearby, land = the appraiser's land value / this ratio

impact_fees.basis: City of Tampa multimodal transportation fee (middle of its 6 fee districts, July 1, 2026 rates) plus the Hillsborough County school impact fee by living area. Water and wastewater capacity fees are not included yet.

components.name: City of Tampa multimodal transportation impact fee
components.note: Middle of the 6 districts (Central Business, Central East, Interbay, North Central, University North, Westshore) for detached single family by living area and low-rise multifamily not close to transit. Range across districts: $2,037 to $4,096 for a 1,500 to 2,499 sq ft house; $1,245 to $2,509 per low-rise apartment. Phased: higher rates start July 1, 2027 and July 1, 2028.

components.name: Hillsborough County school impact fee (countywide)
components.note: Same table in the city's copy (updated 2020-06-05) and the county's 2022 residential sheet.

rents.range_basis: 10th-90th percentile over 48 tracts of ACS 2020-2024 rent of units built 2010-2019 over all rented units
rents.evidence: python -m jobs.check_rents_acs: ACS 2020-2024 B25111 (median gross rent of units built 2010-2019) over B25064 (all rented units), median over 48 tracts with lots in Tampa. Units built 2020 or later: 1.124 over 12 tracts.
rents.caveat: Census rents include long-tenure leases and utilities; no public rent rolls outside Chicago. Replace with a rent source when one is available.

property_tax.basis: 19.7353 mills on taxable value x 0.85 (Florida just value is set near 85% of sale price after the 15% cost-of-sale deduction, s. 193.011(8))
property_tax.rate_note: Hillsborough County 2026 final millage inside the City of Tampa: county 5.3608, environmental lands 0.0604, library 0.5583, schools 6.3340, port 0.0722, HART transit 0.5000, Children's Board 0.4589, SWFWMD 0.1831, City of Tampa 6.2076.
property_tax.caveat: Non-homestead rate for an in-city lot; special districts some lots pay are not included.
